description: Use when an agent must receive a webhook or callback (payment, CI, form) but has no public server. Input: ttl_hours 1-168 (default 24). Output: public url https://1gateway.dev/h/…, id, one-time secret, read URL. Any method is stored (method, query, headers incl. signatures, body), answered 200. Reads free (header x-webhook-secret), ?wait=1-25 long-polls. Receive only; 50 requests, 64 KB each. Example: GET /v1/agent/webhook?ttl_hours=24 Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

ttl_hours.description: Hours the URL stays live, 1-168 (default 24); the URL and every stored request are deleted after

name: agent_webhook
title: Agent webhook inbox: a public URL that stores incoming HTTP requests (webhooks, callbacks) for an agent to read, 1-168 h
